remarks: Stunning views from this highly desirable townhouse complex in Wilton! The unit has 2 large bedrooms and a brand new deck with a side yard, that most units in the complex do not have, perfect for family, friends or pets to get out for some fresh air. Central air and heat with hardwood floors and a wood burning fireplace in the family room. The kitchen has a ton of cabinet and counter space and is connected to the dining room and family room. 1 car garage space comes with the unit and you are within walking distance to town and all shop and restaurants. Come check it out before it's gone!
